high_level_description: The image depicts a group of individuals standing outdoors in front of a multi-story building with large windows. The building appears to be modern, with a neutral color palette and some greenery visible on the right side of the frame. The group consists of seven people, four men and three women, all dressed in traditional Indian attire. The men are wearing white kurta-pajama sets with intricate embroidery and orange and green borders. They also have small Indian flags attached to their outfits.
